The Taxation Laws (Amendment) Ordinance, 2019 contained substantial amendments in the Income Tax Act 1961 and the Finance (No.2) Act, 2019 which had provided an option todomestic companies to pay income tax at a concessional rate subject to certain conditions. The Company had elected to apply the concessional tax rate and has recognized the provisionfor income tax and re-measured the net deferred tax liabilities at concessional rate from the financial year 2019-20. Further, the subsidiary company VLS Securities Limited has also electedto exercise the option permitted under section 115BAA of the Income Tax Act, 1961 from current financial year i.e. 2020-21.
